title: onoclea sensibilis var. obtusilobata
intro: Onoclea sensibilis var. obtusilobata, commonly known as the Autumn fern or the Sensitive fern, is a species of fern in the family Onocleaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Onoclea sensibilis var. obtusilobata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe digestive issues, calm skin irritations, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine.
